name: Olaf
def: Free walking robotic version of the snowman from Frozen, built by Walt Disney Imagineering to roam among guests in its World of Frozen lands.
facts: Debuted at Disneyland Paris in November 2025
Planned for the World of Frozen areas in Paris and Hong Kong
